title: Paper Blocks
tagline: Stack the falling blocks and clear lines.

controls.keyboard: Arrows move, Up/X rotate, Z rotate back, Space drop, C hold, P pause

description: The classic falling-block puzzle on graph paper. Seven pieces from a shuffled bag, SRS rotation with wall kicks, a ghost piece showing where you will land, hold, a next queue, lock delay, and levels that speed the game up. Clear four lines at once for a big score, and chain back-to-back clears for a bonus.
